items.text: In the formula 参数新值 = 参数旧值 - 学习率 × 梯度, why does subtracting the product of learning rate and gradient guarantee the parameter moves in the direction that reduces loss?(复习题)

A. Because the gradient is always positive, so subtracting it always decreases the parameter,thus reducing loss B. Because the minus sign ensures that regardless of whether the gradient is positive or negative, the parameter moves in the direction that reduces loss C. Because the learning rate is always positive, multiplying it with any gradient yields a positive value, and subtracting a positive value decreases the parameter D. Because the gradient represents the correct direction for adjustment, and the subtraction cancels out the gradient's effect
